title: AIDD marketplace package manifest
description: One catalog/packages/<id>/package.json per installable package. Validated by skill/scripts/validate_catalog_entry.py before a submission is accepted.

id.description: Must match the containing folder name exactly (catalog/packages/<id>/).

kind.description: provider = tasks_to_issues.py issue tracker; adapter = agent command target; template = a spec/design-system template; hook = a Claude Code enforcement hook. Determines which install-destination convention applies — see catalog/README.md. All four kinds are installable: 'adapter' and 'template' are a plain file copy into the target project. 'provider' and 'hook' are also a plain file copy, but the package's own 'files' map must land its manifest.json plus its code/script file(s) together under .aidd/extensions/<id>/ in the target project — skill/scripts/extension_registry.py auto-discovers anything under .aidd/extensions/**/manifest.json, so the package is live immediately after install with no further wiring. See skill/scripts/extension_registry.py's own docstring for the manifest.json shape a provider/hook package must ship.

files.description: Maps a destination path (relative to the installing project root) to a source path relative to this package's own files/ folder. Every source path is validated to resolve inside files/ — no '..', no absolute paths.
